# Andrew R. Tools

Andrew R. is an independent software developer and designer specializing in automation tools and plugins for creative professionals. 

## Key Products

### Arrange Master
Arrange Master is the true-shape nesting and layout automation plugin for Adobe Illustrator. It saves designers and print shops hours of manual work by using advanced mathematics to pack vector and raster objects efficiently. It includes Grid Layout, Bounds Packing, Dense Packing (true-shape nesting), Shape Respect, Single Item Fill and Disperse. Personal License costs USD 39 for 1 device, Team License USD 79 for up to 3 devices, and Extended Commercial License USD 159 for up to 8 devices. These are one-time purchases with lifetime licenses.
